item.title: Intergenerational Extraction in Liberal Democracies
item.description: This report explores the thesis that liberal democracy can become systematically biased toward present voters and against younger and future cohorts, functioning as intergenerational extraction.

item.title: Liberalism, Social Disembedding, and Managed Dependency
item.description: This report explores the thesis that actually existing liberalism, especially when fused to advanced capitalism, tends to dissolve pre-liberal or nonmarket social bonds, reconstructing social coordination through commodified, bureaucratic, therapeutic, credentialed, and managerial mechanisms that create new dependencies.
